title: bsc_7 (held rounds): live gate, Phase 2f confirmation and stop-limited sweep levels
written: 2026-10-07, before calibration O and before any bsc_7 run
change: A filtering round that breaks a validity bound (flagged fraction >= 0.5 or informative mass < 0.25) is HELD: the global model is left unchanged, nothing is applied, revoked or committed to client state; the run stops only when a third consecutive round is invalid (max_consecutive_holds = 2). Motivated by addendum A19: the confirmed bsc_6 configuration stopped on fresh seed 79 at round 2 (two honest early-round false alarms plus two attackers = 4/8). --hold-policy stop reproduces bsc_6.
equivalence_argument: Thresholds, profiles and clip bounds are fitted without the hold policy, and a held round only replaces what bsc_6 did at a stop. Hence every bsc_6 run that completed without a stop is unchanged under bsc_7; only previously stopped runs can differ. This is verified on the live gate (calibration O's phases, clip bounds and profiles must equal calibration N's; the gate runs must match logs/bsc6_devgate round by round).
calibration: logs/bsc7_calO, refit from the same controls/captures/cached measurements as calibration N (no training, no inference). All bsc_7 runs below must use a calibration with its detector core digest.

step_1_live_gate.what: --development-gate-run, immediate attack (Phase 2d attack), development seeds 43 and 46, output logs/bsc7_devgate

step_2_phase_2f.runs: MediShield clean+attacked (--live-gate-dir logs/bsc7_devgate), FedAvg clean+attacked, oracle residual; Phase 2d attack
step_2_phase_2f.criteria: identical to PREREGISTRATION_phase2d_bsc5_histoff.json per_seed_criteria and decision rule; a run stopped after 3 consecutive invalid rounds fails

step_3_sweep_levels_rerun.what: malicious ratio 0.25 and 0.5 on seeds 79-81 with bsc_7 (same settings as Stage 3b), outputs logs/stage3c_ratio_0p25_* and logs/stage3c_ratio_0p5_*; descriptive, compared with the bsc_6 sweep; these seeds were already seen, so this is not confirmatory

rule: Earlier verdicts stay on record unchanged. No setting, threshold or criterion changes after any bsc_7 data are seen.
